title: Empathy Development (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to build empathy for their children and partners, strengthening emotional safety and connection.
learningOutcomes: Understand empathy in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise how lack of empathy harms children.
Learn how to understand children’s emotional experiences.

modules.title: Empathy in Fathering
modules.content: Explores how empathy supports children’s emotional development.

modules.title: Barriers to Empathy
modules.content: Identifies patterns that block emotional understanding.

modules.title: Building Empathy
modules.content: Provides tools for perspective-taking and compassion.
